correctness.rationale: Independent replay in this audit (stdlib-only check on inputs/artifacts/witness.json) confirms: both 10x10 grids are Latin (all rows/columns are permutations of 0..9), SIG=[1,2,0,4,5,3,7,8,6,9] has cycle profile [1,3,3,3] and satisfies SIG^3=id, G[SIG[r]][SIG[c]]==SIG[G[r][c]] holds at all 100 cells for both G in {A,B} (diagonal order-3 autotopism), fixed cell (9,9)->9 in both squares, and the 100 superimposed pairs (A[r][c],B[r][c]) are pairwise distinct (100/100 orthogonality). The OA(4,10) reading (r,c,A[r][c],B[r][c]) is therefore valid and closed under (sigma,sigma,sigma,sigma). TARGET route (claim_route=TARGET in research_report.json) matches topic target_claim literally, so no fallback logic applies. No ADMISSION_DEFECT: cycle arithmetic is consistent and non-vacuous.

originality.rationale: Fused live search (SerpBase+Serpent/OpenAlex/Crossref, 9 provider calls, partial=false) over literal, equivalent OA/autotopism, and broader census wordings found no prior decision on an OA(4,10) with order-3 3+3+3+1 autotopism on all four coordinates. Egan-Wanless (arXiv:1406.3681) exhausts only n<=9 plus a near-triple at 10; Wanless MOLS data page catalogues species only to order 9 with random/relation samples at 10; Gill-Wanless relation-pair census counts relation-satisfying pairs (templates 4444/44222) without cycle-profile autotopism classification; Sloane OA library row oa.100.4.10.2 records existence of some OA(4,10) (Parker phenomenon), not this symmetric subtype. No database row, theorem, or construction substantively implies the refined joint-symmetry existence. DRAFT's honest Parker-corpus-diff limitation does not weaken the headline, which claims existence with the prescribed profile, not corpus-wide isotopic novelty.

value.rationale: TARGET positive resolution admitted as independently valuable: first explicit order-10 orthogonal pair carrying the minimal-fixed-point semiregular C3 action (3+3+3+1) jointly on rows, columns, and both symbol sets. Object (OA(4,10)) and invariant (joint order-3 autotopism profile) were motivated before computation as symmetric seeds for triple-extension attacks and as a test of whether order-3 symmetry survives orthogonality at the critical order 10; the value is not known or mechanically implied and a future triple-hunter or symmetry-guided SAT builder could reasonably need this exact witness. This is a rigorously verified exact datum about a natural object, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration, and the incomplete surrounding census (full group, full corpus diff) is honestly disclosed without erasing the headline.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A broader pair census defeats originality only if it substantively implies or exhaustively covers the named subtype. Relation counts and small-order classifications do not propositionally entail existence or nonexistence of a semiregular order-3 pair at order 10, so broader coverage does not subsume the headline.

claim_vs_prior_implication.evidence: Parker (1959-60) constructions prove some order-10 pairs exist; single-square automorphism theory (e.g., diagonally cyclic squares, cycle-structure autotopism papers) constrains one Latin square, not joint orthogonality; parity-of-MOLS files exhibit parities, not this autotopism. No source exhibits or refutes a 3+3+3+1 joint autotopism pair.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Prior existence of some pair and single-square symmetry lemmas do not logically imply the refined joint claim: orthogonality plus simultaneous equivariance of both squares is an extra constraint, and orbit-level assignments exist before orthogonality bites (nonvacuous). Hence the witness adds new propositional content.

perplexity_final_check.rationale: Terminal Perplexity check (20 results, 7 URL-overlaps with the base providers) added useful adjacent recall but no decisive prior. Incremental leads — the Gill-Wanless arXiv abstract, PAG prescribed-autotopy manual, MOLR autotopism framework, single-square cycle-structure theory, and Delisle two-relation enumeration — were compared literally on hypotheses versus conclusions: each concerns a different invariant (F2-relations), object level (single squares or triples), symmetry type (transpose-conjugation rather than diagonal C3), or general tooling, and none exhibits, classifies, or implies an OA(4,10) with diagonal autotopism (sigma,sigma,sigma,sigma) of profile 3+3+3+1 on all four coordinates. Overlapping hits duplicated base evidence (Wanless data, Egan-Wanless, McKay counts). Originality PASS therefore stands; correctness and value are untouched and the public package is preserved.
